newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe says shareholders approve spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe says shareholders approve spinoff.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources said Tuesday its shareholders approved the spinoff of Monterey Resources Inc.
The company said its board declared the distribution of all its common stock of Monterey Resources to its common shareholders.
Santa Fe Energy owns 45,350,000 shares of Monterey's common stock and the distribution will be tax-free to Santa Fe and its shareholders.
For each share of Santa Fe Energy, stockholders will receive approximately 0.44 of a share of common stock in Monterey Resources.
Santa Fe shareholders of record on July 18 will receive the distribution which will occur on or about July 25.
